name: TTY dispatch
prose: an interactive terminal gets the TUI; no TTY (desktop entry, `< NUL`) hands over to the GUI; `--gui` forces the GUI from a terminal. Per OS: linux wrapper, mac `Resources/bin/magentra`, and the TUI's own fallback on Windows.
invariant: --gui or the absence of an interactive TTY hands over to the desktop app and exits, which is the universal fallback the Windows cmd shim cannot provide.
